meta.notes: Berger: newest edition is the 2026 catalog (English PDF dated 2026-01-21, linked from the "2026 Catalogs" nav item); it lists part #, sectional density, G1/G7 BC, G7 form factor and minimum twist but no dimensions. Dimensions (OAL = lengthIn, boat tail, nose length, base to ogive, bearing surface, diameter) come from the live bergerbullets.com "Bullet Reference Charts" page, cross-checked against the 2024 catalog reference charts and a few product pages. Value precedence: BC/SD/form factor/twist = 2026 catalog > web chart > product page > 2024 catalog; dimensions = web chart > product page > 2024 catalog, except where the web value breaks Berger's own OAL = nose + bearing + boat tail relation by > 0.05 in and a conflicting catalog value restores it (explained per record). Every disagreement is kept in "conflicts". Berger twist values are MINIMUM twist. Berger ammunition tables (catalog pp.13-15) are not bullets and are not extracted. Lapua: 2026 English catalog (PDF dated 2026-03-23) components tables p.18 (rifle + handgun) are primary; lapua.com product pages cross-checked; catalog p.12 velocity-banded G1 BCs go to bcNotes (military AP/API bullets on p.12 are not reloading components and are skipped). Lapua publishes bullet dimensions only for the TRX bullets (product pages, lengthConfidence "high"); other Lapua lengths come from the Lapua-distributed QuickTARGET file lapua.bul (unlabeled column, lengthConfidence "low", only when code, weight, diameter and G1 BC agree with the catalog). Lapua ids use the bullet code (lapua-gb544); sku = Lapua product no. Field conventions: evidence holds one verbatim (whitespace-collapsed) text line per source, in the same order as "sources", joined by " || " (PDF table rows rebuilt from pdftotext word boxes keep the PDF words in reading order); recommendedTwist is the string as printed, twistInches its number; construction is mapped from the maker's wording quoted in notes, null when the wording does not state it. Extra fields beyond the requested schema: noseLengthIn, bearingSurfaceIn, sectionalDensity, g7FormFactor, lengthConfidence, bulletCode, weightG, diameterMm, twistInches, firearm, conflicts.
